The '''Junquers system''' was presumed, by [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]], to be the location where the [[motoball]] [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]], [[EL-434]], was built.<ref name="OS" />

==Behind the scenes==

{{Quote|Alliance intelligence guesses he was built in the Junquers system, and that EL-434 has been active for many years.|EL-434 bio|<ref name="OS" />}}

The Junquers system was first mentioned in [[Bill Slavicsek]]'s [[1989]] ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' adventure, ''[[Otherspace (adventure)|Otherspace]]''. The system received a single mention in the bio for Imperial agent, EL-434, a [[cerillium]] composite [[motoball]] assassin droid captured by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]], that was being held aboard the ''[[Celestial (starship)|Celestial]]'' alongside [[Tolonda sector/Legends|Tolonda sector]]'s [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Ravik/Legends|Ravik]] and [[Imperial Outer Rim Territories Patrol Fleet]] commander, [[Bane Nothos]].<ref name="OS" />
